format.hours: [days, from, to] or [days, from, to, 'by knock'], game time on a 24-hour clock; a window whose to is before or equal to from ends the next morning; [] means no public hours

open_points: Hours: G10 and BLUEPRINT-04 4.3.3 won every time. Older hook-cast.json hours lost: Mickey's 07:00 to 27:00 (now round the clock with the counter 07:00 to 22:00), the fish market 07:30 to 14:00 (Laverack's follows the shops), Rita's Wednesday to 13:00 and Hal's Wednesday to 13:00 (no early closing day: G10 gives Monday to Saturday 09:00 to 17:30), the launderette 08:00 to 17:30 (now 08:00 to 23:00), the caff 06:30 to 22:00 every day (now 06:00 to 15:00, Friday and Saturday to 22:00), the newsagent 06:00 to 17:30 (now 18:00), the market on Tuesday, Friday and Saturday (now Thursday). The prototype's boxing 17:00 to 22:00, launderette 08:00 to 20:00, tea room 09:00 to 17:00 and coin shop 10:00 to 16:00 lost the same way.

Early closing: shop-hours-1990 finds the Shops Act 1950 required one early-closing afternoon a week (Thursday in Hull and Grimsby, but no 1990 day found) and says the day is the shopkeeper's choice since 1965. G10 and 4.3.3 give Monday to Saturday 09:00 to 17:30 with no early closing, so none is built; Thursday is market day and empties the shops by a third instead. Recommend the keeper confirms.

Two pawns are kept (map open_points): Rita's at 5 Quay Street keeps the Quay Street shops' hours with a back room by knock 17:30 to 22:00 (chosen), Wayne Harrison's at 16 North Road has G10's pawn hours 10:00 to 17:00 and back room to 22:00.

Sunday: the launderette is open every day 08:00 to 23:00 as G10 gives no day split (chosen reading: not a shop under the Act). The caff is open Sunday 08:00 to 12:00 (hook-cast.json, chosen; meals are legal on Sunday). The chip shop is shut Sunday until the paper's issue_10 (9 Nov) says Mr Dobson opens Sundays from that week: from Sun 11 Nov it opens 17:00 to 22:00 (chosen), which the Act (shop-hours-1990) forbids for fried fish and chips; the street can know it is a breach.

The paper's issue_11 (16 Nov) says the Washeteria keeps its last wash at 16:30 after a machine was put out of order; G10 says 08:00 to 23:00. Both kept: the hours stand, the last wash is 16:30 from Fri 16 Nov (an event in timetables.json). Decide whether the premises close earlier.

Hours chosen (not in any source): snooker hall Mon to Sat 11:00 to 22:30 (shut Sunday); pigeon loft 07:00 to 19:00 daily (birds flown Sat and Sun 14:00 to 16:00); fishing spots 05:00 to 23:00 (best bites 05:30 to 09:00 and 16:00 to 20:00); allotments 07:00 to 19:00; cold stores 06:00 to 17:30 Mon to Fri, 06:00 to 13:00 Sat; customs and Harbour Board 09:00 to 16:30 Mon to Fri; Holt's garage; Agar's agents; Iveson's yard (prototype 07:30 to 17:00, kept); the net store; the barber (09:00 to 17:00); the chapel (08:00 to 18:00, Sunday to 19:00); the retired doctor by knock 08:00 to 21:00; the gun seller 00:30 to 02:30 after Tuesday's and Friday's evening.

Mickey's office hours: the blueprint says the firm runs day and night and the radio is manned. Built as an open door and rank round the clock, counter 07:00 to 22:00, radio manned always (Pauline by day, the night driver on the set and the rung-3 night desk by night, chosen). The older 07:00 to 27:00 is lost.

Market: the ruled Thursday market is in Copper Row (off the map; 2.1.6); the paper's issue_02 says Copper Row runs Tuesday, Friday and Saturday 08:00 to 16:00 and loses (fix that line). For the Hook the brief's on-map option is chosen: four trestles and a barrow on the quay road's north pavement between Rinaldi's and Quay Street's foot, Thursday 08:00 to 16:00 (market_stalls_quay).

RT2-14: 'on Tuesdays and Fridays, after midnight' is read as the small hours after those evenings (00:30 to 02:30 on the clock of Wednesday and Saturday); the seller is an unnamed deckhand (person_ref). Mickey's desk drawer has no coordinates (the interior is in rooms.json): the bottom right-hand drawer, chosen.
Cold stores: the brief's 17:30 packing shift and the blueprint's 'half past five' mornings are both kept: a day shift leaving 17:30 and a night shift leaving 05:30 (chosen split).

At 23:00 on every night of the week at least three places are open with people in them (open_hours_check_2300): Monday to Saturday Mickey's, Regent House, the chip shop (to 23:30; to 00:30 Friday and Saturday), the landing's window (22:00 to 01:00) and the tea stall (22:00 to 06:00); Sunday (the chip shop shut until 22:00 from 11 Nov, before that shut all day) Mickey's, Regent House, the landing's window and the tea stall. The launderette closes at 23:00 and is not counted; the snooker hall closes at 22:30.

Ids: places with no plot (spots, off-map places, the soft edges) use the map's ids; places invented here (toms_flat, mickeys_inner_office, mickeys_desk_drawer, mickeys_yard, harbour_board_back_office, market_stalls_quay, bonfire_ground, fireworks_quay, copper_row_market, ropewalk_park, drill_hall, the_exchange_march, solicitor_office, pillar boxes) hang on an existing plot or use the map's coordinates and add no geometry. Bonfire ground (440, 312) is free ground in the map (no plot) but has no road of its own: access by the warehouse row. The soft edge's constable hour is 22:00 to 06:00 (G5), delay 30 game minutes (60 real seconds at 120 s an hour, was 30 s).

Old and new real-time figures from this file: the edge's 30 game minutes out and back is 60 real seconds (was 30 s at 60 s an hour); the landing window 22:00 to 01:00 is 6 real minutes (was 3); the chapel hall's evening 2.5 game hours is 5 real minutes (was 2.5).
